outcome: Maternal glucose homeostasis parameters (fasting glucose, insulin, C peptide, HbA1c, IR HOMA)
cohort: The study included 55 women diagnosed with GDM and 110 healthy pregnant women, along with their newborns.
finding: Adipolin levels did not differ between GDM and healthy mothers or their newborns, but were higher in GDM women delivering via cesarean section; conversely, adiponectin levels were significantly lower in GDM mothers and their newborns, with GDM associated with an increased risk of adverse events and macrosomia.
mod_finding: Adipolin levels were significantly higher in GDM patients who gave birth via cesarean section (p = 0.01).
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken during the second trimester and the prepartum period.
birth_weight: N/A (macrosomia was an outcome, but specific birth weights of included babies were not mentioned)
gest_age: N/A (measurements taken during the second trimester for mothers, but specific gestational age of babies at birth not mentioned)
